entryProofs.title: Module 3: Three.js Scene, Camera, and Selection
excerpts: Module 3 covers days 5–6 of the course: **3 solo hours followed by a 1-hour webinar with the teacher** [1].

entryProofs.title: Module 6: Particle Systems and Resource Management
excerpts: Module 6 covers days 11–12 of the course. Schedule: **3 solo hours**, then **1 teacher webinar hour**. Project work adds **2 further solo hours** on those same days, kept separate from module hours. Total module time: 4 hours (3 solo + 1 webinar). [1]

entryProofs.title: Modules 4–5: Inertia, Springs, and Interpolation
excerpts: Modules 4 and 5 cover motion mechanics after pointer release: velocity-driven inertia (Module 4, days 7–8) and spring-based interpolation (Module 5, days 9–10). Each module follows the same schedule: **3 solo hours then 1 teacher webinar hour**.

entryProofs.title: Module 7: View State and Navigation History
excerpts: Module 7 covers view selection state, bounded navigation history, and browser URL/popstate restoration. It occupies **days 13–14**: 3 solo hours, then 1 webinar hour with the teacher. An additional 2 solo project hours run on those same days but are tracked separately (see the PROJECT protocol) [1].
